earth.desc: a hulking moss-covered stone golem with gold-banded boulder fists, a glowing green crystal in its chest and little bonsai trees and moss growing on its head, shoulders and back
earth.motion: the leaves of the little trees and the hanging moss tufts sway gently, the green chest crystal pulses brighter and dimmer, a few tiny leaves drift

fire.desc: a red fire dragon with cream horns, a spiky red mane, glowing molten-orange cracks on its chest and belly, and large red wings raised behind it
fire.motion: the wing membranes ripple slightly and the wing tips lift and lower a little, the tail tip curls gently, the molten cracks pulse with glow, small embers rise from the mane

ice.desc: a white and blue frost beast with crystalline ice feathers, a feathered ice crest, a blue crystal gem on its chest and a large fluffy feathered tail
ice.motion: the crest feathers and tail feathers ruffle softly, the chest gem shimmers, tiny snow sparkles glint around the feathers

lightning.desc: a purple storm beast with golden flame-shaped horns and spikes, a lavender mane, and a crackling violet flame on its tail tip
lightning.fixed: legs, claws, golden horns and spikes
lightning.motion: the lavender mane fur ripples, tiny violet sparks crackle along the gold spikes, the tail-tip flame flickers and curls

mire.desc: a swamp mushroom shaman with a huge spotted purple mushroom cap, a tattered mossy green robe and a twisted staff topped with little glowing mushrooms
mire.motion: the ragged robe hem and moss tatters sway, the little mushrooms on the staff glow brighter and dimmer, a few tiny spores drift up
mire.windup: it draws the mushroom staff back and the staff mushrooms glow brighter
mire.strike: the staff thrust forward in a spell release, glowing staff tip pointing

scarab.desc: a golden armoured scarab beetle with a teal gem-inlaid shell, a radiant golden sun-crest on its head and curved golden mandibles, standing on golden legs
scarab.motion: the teal shell gems glint and pulse, the sun-crest rays shimmer with light, the shell rises and falls very slightly
scarab.windup: it rears up slightly on its back legs, mandibles opening, the sun-crest glowing
scarab.strike: a lunging mandible snap, head and front legs pushed forward

leviathan.desc: a teal sea-serpent dragon with pink coral antlers, pink-edged fins along its coiled body and a cream belly
leviathan.fixed: coiled body, front claws, coral antlers
leviathan.motion: the pink fins and fin frills ripple as if underwater, the whiskers drift, the tail-tip fin waves gently, a few tiny bubbles rise
leviathan.windup: it coils tighter and draws its head back, jaws closed, fins flaring
leviathan.strike: a lunging bite, head and neck thrust forward with jaws open

colossus.desc: a bronze clockwork golem with huge riveted fists, a glowing cyan gear core in its chest and cyan lights in its armour
colossus.motion: the cyan chest core and the cyan lights in the armour pulse brighter and dimmer, the gear ring around the chest core turns slowly; no steam, no smoke, no particles
colossus.windup: it draws its huge right fist back, the cyan core glowing brighter
colossus.strike: a heavy forward punch with the giant fist

prism.desc: a crystalline mantis-fairy with iridescent lavender crystal wings, a crown of purple crystals, long antennae and slender clawed limbs
prism.motion: the crystal wings flutter gently and shimmer with rainbow light, the antennae sway, small sparkles glint on the crystals
prism.windup: it raises its crystal claws and its wings spread a little, the crystal crown glowing
prism.strike: a forward claw thrust releasing a small attached crystal glow at the claw tips

reaper.desc: a small hooded reaper in a tattered dark-blue cloak with glowing cyan eyes in the shadowed hood, holding a crescent-bladed scythe
reaper.motion: the tattered cloak hem, the ragged hood tip and the torn sleeves flutter and ripple, the cyan eyes glow brighter and dimmer
reaper.windup: it lifts the scythe back over its shoulder, eyes glowing brighter
reaper.strike: a forward scythe swing, the blade sweeping down in front

roc.desc: a giant teal and white roc eagle with gold-trimmed feathers, a hooked golden beak and large raised wings
roc.motion: the wing feathers and head crest feathers ruffle in the wind, the tail feathers sway slightly
roc.windup: it rears back and lifts its wings higher, beak open
roc.strike: a forward strike with beak and lowered head, wings beating forward

briar.desc: a thorny rose dryad queen made of green vines with red roses, a rose crown and a gown of leaves and red petals
briar.motion: the leaves, rose petals and loose vine tendrils sway and curl, a single petal drifts
briar.windup: it draws its vine arms back and the roses glow and open wider
briar.strike: both vine arms thrust forward, thorny vine tendrils lashing a short way out from its hands

seraph.desc: a golden armoured angel knight with a halo crown, large cream feathered wings and a big golden sword planted point-down
seraph.motion: the wing feathers ruffle softly and the wings lift and settle very slightly, the halo glows brighter and dimmer, tiny golden sparkles glint
seraph.windup: it lifts the golden sword up and back with both hands, halo glowing brighter
seraph.strike: a forward overhead sword slash, the blade brought down in front

eclipse.desc: a dark purple eclipse dragon with gold-trimmed horns and armour plates, starry night-sky wing membranes and glowing violet runes
eclipse.motion: the stars in the wing membranes twinkle and the membranes ripple slightly, the violet runes pulse, the tail tip curls gently
eclipse.windup: it draws its head back and lifts its starry wings, the violet runes glowing brighter
eclipse.strike: a lunging forward bite with jaws open and head thrust forward

elderbloom.desc: an ancient treant giant of twisted wood and moss with an antler-like branch crown, small white flowers and a glowing green heart crystal
elderbloom.motion: the leaves, hanging moss and vines sway, the white flowers bob, the green heart crystal pulses brighter and dimmer

cinderheart.desc: a molten lava-rock golem with flaming horns, glowing orange magma cracks and a swirling fire core in its chest
cinderheart.motion: the flames on the horns flicker and curl, the magma cracks pulse with glow, the fire core swirls, small embers drift up

frostregent.desc: an ice queen with long flowing silver-white hair, a crystal crown, a layered pale-blue gown and an ice-crystal staff
frostregent.motion: the long hair and gown layers sway gently, the staff crystal sparkles, a few snowflakes drift

tempestwing.desc: a blue and gold storm griffin with raised blue feathered wings, golden armour plates and glowing blue gems
tempestwing.fixed: legs, talons, beak, armour, wing bones
tempestwing.motion: the wing and neck feathers ruffle, the blue gems flicker with tiny sparks

souljailer.desc: a hooded purple wraith jailer with a large scythe, a hanging soul lantern, a glowing violet core in its chest and tattered purple wisps
souljailer.motion: the tattered purple cloth wisps writhe and flow, the lantern flame flickers, the violet chest core pulses

sporefather.desc: a giant mushroom golem made of red-capped toadstools and moss, holding a staff topped with glowing mushrooms
sporefather.motion: the glowing mushrooms pulse brighter and dimmer, the hanging moss sways

prismback.desc: a colossal tortoise carrying a castle of blue crystals, little trees and waterfalls on its shell
prismback.motion: the little waterfalls flow, the blue crystals sparkle and pulse, the small trees sway

sandchronarch.desc: a golden sand djinn with a crowned turbaned head, golden armour, flowing golden sashes and a swirling sand tail instead of legs
sandchronarch.motion: the swirling sand tail flows and churns, the golden sashes ripple, the teal gems glow

coraltide.desc: a coral sea-serpent queen with pink-red coral antlers, teal and white scales and a long coiled body
coraltide.motion: the fins and coral fronds ripple as if underwater, a few tiny bubbles rise

moonfang.desc: an armoured werewolf knight in dark steel armour with violet moon glow, a purple cape and a sword held point-down
moonfang.motion: the purple cape and fur ruff sway, the violet glow pulses
